newsitem.title: USA: Dow up more than 100 as U.S. stocks storm higher.
newsitem.headline: Dow up more than 100 as U.S. stocks storm higher.

text.p: The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up more than 100 points in late trading as investors spied a chance to buy at low prices after yesterday's sharp losses, traders said.
The 30-stock average was up 105, or 1.39 percent to 7,709 in late trading. It then moved even higher, up nearly 123 or 1.6 percent to about 7727.

Traders said stocks were bouncing back as investors re-evaluated comments by Japan's prime minister, which yesterday sparked fears about a possible Japanese sale of U.S. government bonds. The Dow fell 192 points on Monday.
